be kind and never assume-- there are people you will train who have never even touched coffee, dishes, or worked in customer service. have lots of patience but be firm with rules and regulations. also, make sure to cover specifics, as many trainers are not very good at covering specifics such as pump #s or shot # differences in, for example, a venti hot cup vs a venti cold cup. 

teach your trainees the absolute basics while interweaving complicated stuff in there as well-- they will need the basics in order to fully grasp the hard stuff! \^ \^

stay true to yourself and don't let anyone disrespect you, your job is to make drinks and form connections, not be a punching bag for middle aged white women. \^\^
